settings.title: Whole-person care,
settings.intro: Whether it's a sudden cold, a lingering ache, or a hard week that needs talking through, Carebridge connects you to the right provider — quickly and without the runaround.

features.title: Primary care
features.text: Annual check-ins, chronic-condition management, prescriptions, and referrals — handled by providers who know you and follow up.

features.title: Urgent care
features.text: Rashes, infections, fevers, and injuries seen the same day. Get a diagnosis and treatment plan without a 4-hour emergency-room wait.

features.title: Behavioral health
features.text: Licensed therapists and psychiatric providers for anxiety, depression, stress, and life transitions — with the same clinician across sessions.

features.title: Prescriptions & labs
features.text: Medications sent to your pharmacy and lab orders at a nearby draw station, with results explained to you directly by your provider.

features.title: Secure messaging
features.text: A HIPAA-secure message thread with your care team between visits — ask follow-up questions without booking another appointment.
features.detail: A care team in your pocket

features.title: Family & employer plans
features.text: Add your family on one account, or offer Carebridge to your team as a modern employee benefit that actually gets used.

settings.title: Three kinds of care,
settings.intro: Choose the kind of care you need, and Carebridge matches you with a provider who's right for you — with transparent pricing and no surprise bills.

design.title: Annual & preventive visits
design.text: Established patients get yearly check-ins, routine screenings, and proactive guidance from a provider who keeps your history straight.

design.title: Chronic-condition care
design.text: Diabetes, hypertension, asthma, and more — managed with regular follow-ups and clear treatment plans you can actually follow.

build.title: Same-day sick visits
build.text: Sore throat, sinus infection, UTI, or flu? Get seen today and leave with a diagnosis and a treatment plan — no emergency room required.

build.title: Lab & imaging orders
build.text: Your provider orders labs at a nearby station and follows up to explain results and adjust your plan.

launch.title: One-on-one therapy
launch.text: Licensed therapists for anxiety, depression, burnout, and life transitions — consistent, judgment-free, and covered by most plans.

launch.title: Medication management
launch.text: Psychiatric providers who evaluate, prescribe, and adjust when needed, with check-ins between visits.

settings.title: From sign-up
settings.intro: Care is simpler when the process isn't a maze. Here's exactly what happens after you make an account.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.text: Add your basics, insurance or payment, and what you'd like help with — it takes about two minutes on any device.

steps.title: Pick a provider
steps.text: Choose a time that works and a provider who fits. Most patients are matched with a board-certified clinician in minutes.

steps.title: Meet by video
steps.text: Join a secure video visit right from your browser or the app. No downloads, no waiting rooms.

steps.title: Get your plan
steps.text: Leave with a clear diagnosis, treatment plan, and any prescriptions sent to your pharmacy automatically.

steps.title: Stay connected
steps.text: Follow up by secure message, track your plan, and see your provider again if you need — continuity is the point.

settings.note: Most of our patients say the same thing after their first visit: they can't believe care was ever this easy to get.

settings.title: Before you book,
settings.intro: The questions patients ask most before their first visit.

items.question: Is Carebridge a real doctor, or an algorithm?
items.answer: Every visit is with a real, board-certified physician, nurse practitioner, physician assistant, or licensed therapist. There's no AI diagnosis — a human clinician sees you and is responsible for your care.

items.question: Will my insurance cover it?
items.answer: Most major plans cover telehealth visits. We verify your coverage before you book, so you'll know exactly what you'll pay — usually a standard copay, often less than an in-person visit.

items.question: What about prescriptions?
items.answer: When medically appropriate, your provider sends prescriptions electronically to the pharmacy of your choice. Controlled substances follow the same rules as any clinic.

items.question: Can Carebridge handle my chronic condition?
items.answer: For many conditions — diabetes, hypertension, asthma, thyroid, and more — yes. Your provider builds a continuity plan with regular follow-ups. Complex conditions may still need in-person care, and we'll help you get set up.

items.question: What if it's an emergency?
items.answer: Call emergency services first. Carebridge is for non-emergency care and is never a substitute for an ambulance or emergency room when you have a true emergency.
